blind_data_schema.opaque_token_rule: Copy selected choice JSON-string raw bytes as base64; do not parse or map their contents. No unselected document/label value decoding.
blind_data_schema.source_text_rule: Raw selected text, exact character offsets and spelling. Concatenated evidence sentences equal the original selected source. No source rewriting.

catalog.all17_capacity_rule: One shared contiguous exact-offset source partition. Every NLI context/claim pair must fit<=512 tokens for every one of the17 fixed claims; BGE full windows and prefixed queries must each fit<=512.

development_caveat: OriginalTRAIN473 is selected from a predeclared metadata-only eligible pool and used only as PROJECT_DEV without fitting. No originalDEV/TEST or genuinely fresh confirmation claim. One NDA with17 dependent claims cannot establish independent-document or full-benchmark generalization. Exact pretrained model training/export lineage remains unqualified.

exposure_interruptions.after: Confirms exactly1 selected source document decoded.
exposure_interruptions.before_only: Retire all17 DEV forever conservatively and mark source-decode uncertainty; do not claim confirmed source decode.

forecasts.coverage_rule: A retrieval miss never proves NotMentioned. NotMentioned requires every frozen supplied source window consumed. full_reference always consumes all windows without early exit.
forecasts.numeric_rule: Claim numeric literals only; either flag disables early exit. No heuristic label or NEI override.
forecasts.probability_rule: Finite strictly positive double-softmax probabilities; sum tolerance1e-6. Finite stable log probabilities, no clipping or renormalization, abs(exp(logp)-p)<=1e-12. Underflow is an error.
forecasts.row_order: For each of17 fixed case IDs, native_order then source_order then full_reference. Exactly51 rows.

gold.catalog_validation: Custody rehashes exact catalog and original raw bank, independently checks all17 original cases, exact W/schema, contiguous whole-source slices, source-unit overlap membership, source/text hashes and all-source coverage. Token capacity was established under the separately frozen blind tokenizer preparation and independently reviewed; no tokenizer, native or model is rerun at Gold.

Q derives each dictionary independently from actual durable progress; custody physically rehashes exact raw worker/native results and requires exact counter equality, plan/freeze equality and all51 physical DEV rows equal the sealed forecast rows. No empty, arbitrary, boolean or flat fallback; never fill expected counts. At most2 actual native corpus-batch attempts.
gold.forecast_binding: Admission and Q audit carry the exact same canonical path/bytes/SHA256 typed reference; custody physically rehashes it and validates all51 rows before any semantic Gold decode.
gold.official_codec_mapping_caveat: Official loader enum has its own integer numbering, but custody never executes it. Gold joins the literal official string labels only. Forecast model indices0/1/2 remain Contradiction/Entailment/NotMentioned.
gold.per_phase_audit_schema: Separate engineering/dev gate audits may use a flat exact42 observed dictionary for that phase. These are not accepted as the joint late-Gold closure artifact.
gold.present_class_gate: After sealedforecasts and physicalclosure only, require native>=1correct for every actually present Goldclass; absentclasses explicit, never all-class competence.
gold.scoring_owner: Candidate scorer, which separately emits actual_scored_case_ids; publication derives label-only exposures without mutating raw worker results.
